content:
Jules (Finance): CloudAtlas emailed — April invoice looks ~30% high vs their telemetry. Can billing/platform confirm if we overcounted? /cc @Ayesha @Marco
Ayesha (Billing Ops): Pulling ledger vs ingest now. Invoice shows billed_embed_units=1,820,400.
Billing Bot: invoice=2026-05 customer_id=cloudatlas billed_embed_units=1820400 billable_amount=$692.94
Marco (Platform): We had a short-lived sampler rehydrate on 2026-04-11 that had idempotence bugs. Possible double-apply of sample_factor during backfill. Investigating root traces.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): Quick check: sampled traces showing sample_factor applied twice for cloudatlas window => estimated extra_units=1,100,000. Example trace ch-33: raw_units=10 sample_factor=100 applied twice => billed 1000 vs expected 10.
Ayesha (Billing Ops): At CloudAtlas negotiated rate $0.00038/unit delta =~ $418. Round to nearest $10?
Jules (Finance): For processing bug we absorb or credit? This is clearly our bug; approve goodwill credit.
Jules (Finance): Approve $420 credit. Please include CSV evidence and ticket references.
Marco (Platform): Created ticket PLAT-9822: "sampler: ensure idempotent apply of sample_factor during rehydrate/backfill" and INF-9810 for retention of raw diffs.
Billing Bot: credit_queued customer=cloudatlas invoice=2026-04 amount=$420 ref=CA-CR-2034567890 status=queued
Ayesha (Billing Ops): I'll apply the credit and send the customer a short note: apology, root cause, credit applied, and link to mitigation tickets.
CS Bot: Draft message queued for review by Jules.
Jules (Finance): Thanks — attach PLAT-9822 and INF-9810 to the invoice note and run a sweep for other tenants affected during 2026-04-10..2026-04-12.
Ayesha (Billing Ops): Will do and report back in #finance.
